description: The storylines Mappit is following worldwide, ranked as on mappit.ai's Threads page. Each groups many stories about one developing event ("Iran nuclear talks", "Hurricane season"). Optionally one topic or a time window. Use get_thread for one storyline's stories and Mappit's analysis; whats_happening gives the storylines around one place.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page, exactly as returned.

topic.description: A topic slug or name ("world-conflict", "Science"); several separated by commas.

window.description: Only storylines with news in this window. How far back: "24h", "72h", "7d" or "30d" (any number of hours or days up to 30 days). Default: 72h.

name: list_threads
title: List storylines
